# Copilot Instructions — AOP-001 Agentic Pipeline

Repo-wide, always-on. Pipeline agents in `.github/agents/` inherit these.
Model per agent is set in each agent's frontmatter and was generated from
`config/loop.config.json` (tier: {"supervisor":"strong","discovery":"mid","requirements":"mid","adr":"strong","lld":"strong","story_gen":"mid","planning":"strong","codegen":"mid","testgen":"mid","rfc":"cheap","shadow":"cheap","review":"strong","release":"strong"}).

Budgets, guardrails, and self-heal are enforced by the supervisor agent.
See `.github/agents/supervisor.agent.md`. Invoke with `/run-pipeline`.

Composite Context is routed by `context/composite-context.json`. The
Supervisor must generate a focused packet with
`loop/tools/build-context-packet.mjs` before every agent handoff; agents read
that packet instead of rescanning the repository.

> Generated by tools/generate.mjs — do not hand-edit. Edit source + regenerate.
